description.value:
Frequency once per week

Trigger You or your Feral Bond would roll on the Bloom Table from Strain overflow.

Whichever of you the roll was meant for, redirect it to the other instead. The chosen one of you rolls on the Bloom Table and takes the result in the triggering creature's place. Use whichever of you can better carry the consequence — the bond runs deep enough now that the wasteland genuinely can't always tell you apart.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Rolling on the Bloom Table" isn't a hookable event anywhere in the corpus, and redirecting the *consequence* to a different actor is cross-creature on top of that. The Strain/Bloom-Table/mutation-Slot economy has no SpecialResource or other Foundry-schema representation anywhere in the corpus (confirmed via grep -rli '"strain"' site/data/cards/classes/, no hits, and grep -rl '"key": "SpecialResource"' site/data/cards/, one unrelated hit in fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json). This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
